in_sanskrit.name: Najim
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious, Triumphant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Najim एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘naj’, which means ‘victorious’ or ‘triumphant’. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with gods such as Lord Vishnu and Lord Hanuman, who are revered for their strength and power.
